frontmatter.title: Personal Portfolio (V1)
frontmatter.subheading: Vanilla Webpack/Handlebars static portfolio with ADRs
frontmatter.excerpt: A purposefully vanilla static portfolio - Webpack 5, Handlebars, and Sass composing JSON-at-build content into a single-page showcase and a first-class design-system page, with GitHub Pages CI and a formal ADR practice.
frontmatter.problem: I needed a credible online presence and a freeCodeCamp-compliant portfolio without adopting a framework I could not yet justify - and I wanted the architecture decisions written down, not buried in tribal knowledge.
frontmatter.approach: Constrained the stack to vanilla HTML/CSS/JS; treated Webpack + Handlebars as a lightweight SSG over JSON content; split the product into a portfolio surface and a design-system surface; recorded nine ADRs and ASRs as the delivery contract.
frontmatter.outcome: Shipped a maintainable static site on GitHub Pages and proved the content-at-build idea that v2 later expanded into typed MDX collections, SEO, and dual hosting.
